name: 98011 · Bothell, WA
findings: ZIP 98011 (Bothell) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98011 (Bothell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
